description: This file implements a Lasso security guardrail for LiteLLM, providing content moderation, PII detection, and policy enforcement via the Lasso API. It defines classes, methods, and error handling for integrating Lasso into the LLM call workflow, including pre-call, moderation, and post-call hooks, with masking and blocking capabilities.

classes.name: LassoResponse
classes.description: Type definition for the response from the Lasso API, including violation detection, deputies, findings, and optional messages.

classes.name: LassoGuardrailMissingSecrets
classes.description: Exception raised when the Lasso API key is missing.

classes.name: LassoGuardrailAPIError
classes.description: Exception raised for errors during Lasso API calls.

classes.name: LassoGuardrail
classes.description: Main class implementing the Lasso security guardrail, handling API interactions, violation processing, masking, and blocking logic for LiteLLM.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LassoGuardrail with API keys, environment variables, and configuration.

methods.name: _generate_ulid
methods.description: Generates a ULID or UUID as a fallback if ULID library is unavailable.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook to validate or modify input before LLM call, including conversation ID management.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: During-call moderation to validate input concurrently with processing.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook to validate and mask the model's response after generation.

methods.name: _get_or_generate_conversation_id
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a conversation ID for session consistency.

methods.name: _run_lasso_guardrail
methods.description: Core method to run the guardrail, handling classification and masking workflows.

methods.name: _handle_masking
methods.description: Handles guardrail masking with the classifix endpoint.

methods.name: _handle_api_error
methods.description: Handles errors from API calls, raising specific exceptions based on error type.

methods.name: _log_masking_applied
methods.description: Logs details when masking is applied to responses.

methods.name: _prepare_headers
methods.description: Prepares HTTP headers for API requests, including API key and session info.

methods.name: _prepare_payload
methods.description: Prepares the JSON payload for API requests, including messages and session info.

methods.name: _call_lasso_api
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous POST request to the Lasso API and returns the response.

methods.name: _process_lasso_response
methods.description: Processes the API response, raising HTTPException if blocking violations are detected.

methods.name: _check_for_blocking_actions
methods.description: Identifies deputies with 'BLOCK' actions in violations to enforce blocking.

methods.name: _parse_violated_deputies
methods.description: Extracts list of deputies that are violated according to the response.

methods.name: _apply_masking_to_model_response
methods.description: Replaces message contents in the model response with masked versions from Lasso.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail.
